sectionSubtitle: Build your career with a collective of passionate technologists. Explore open roles and grow with us.

vacancies.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
vacancies.description: We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Developer proficient in React/Next.js and Node.js to build scalable web applications for global clients.
responsibilities: Design and develop responsive web applications using React, Next.js and Node.js
Collaborate with designers and product managers to ship high-quality features
Write clean, maintainable code and conduct code reviews
Optimize applications for performance and scalability
requirements: 3+ years experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript
Strong knowledge of Node.js, REST APIs, and databases (PostgreSQL/MongoDB)
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD and cloud deployment (Vercel/AWS)

vacancies.title: Flutter Mobile Developer
vacancies.description: Join our mobile team to craft high-performance cross-platform apps using Flutter for diverse clients worldwide.
responsibilities: Build and maintain Flutter applications for iOS and Android
Integrate REST APIs and third-party SDKs
Ensure app performance, quality and responsiveness
Collaborate with backend team and UI/UX designers
requirements: Experience publishing apps to Play Store / App Store
Understanding of Firebase and mobile CI/CD

vacancies.title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer (Intern)
vacancies.description: Kickstart your DevOps career. Learn CI/CD, Docker, and cloud infrastructure while working on real client projects.
responsibilities: Assist in setting up CI/CD pipelines
Help manage Docker containers and cloud servers
Monitor system performance and assist in troubleshooting
requirements: Basic knowledge of Linux, Git and Docker
Familiarity with AWS / Cloudflare / Vercel is a plus
Eagerness to learn DevOps and automation
Currently studying or recent graduate in IT/Computer field
